partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Compact active-component causal module
results.hypothesis: A drug can treat a disease when it directly inhibits one causal gene that is active in the same compact cellular component as a second causal disease gene.
results.body: drug binds and decreases causal gene; second causal gene shares p90-compact GO active-in component
results.mechanism_rationale: ACTIVE_IN localizes the molecular activities of two causal genes to a discrete component, which is stronger functional context than generic component membership, although disease activity direction remains absent.
results.trapi_notes: The target, causal-gene, and active-in paths are TRAPI-expressible; distinct-gene identity, component degree, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (target)-[:ACTIVE_IN]->(component:CellularComponent)
      <-[:ACTIVE_IN]-(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND component._miner_component_active_gene_degree <= 185
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Dual-inhibition active-component causal module
results.hypothesis: An active-component mechanism is most credible when the drug directly binds and decreases both causal genes active in the same compact component.
results.body: drug binds and decreases two causal genes sharing p90-compact GO active-in component
results.mechanism_rationale: Two directional target arms converge on causal activities localized to one discrete component, but the graph still does not state whether either disease driver is overactive or deficient.
results.trapi_notes: The repeated target and active-in paths are TRAPI-expressible; two-target cardinality, component degree, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene1:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect1:AFFECTS]->(gene1)
MATCH (gene1)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (gene1)-[:ACTIVE_IN]->(component:CellularComponent)
      <-[:ACTIVE_IN]-(gene2:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene2)
MATCH (subject)-[effect2:AFFECTS]->(gene2)
MATCH (gene2)-[:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE gene1.id < gene2.id
  AND effect1.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect1.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect1.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND effect2.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect2.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect2.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND component._miner_component_active_gene_degree <= 185
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Direct GO-CAM causal propagation
results.hypothesis: Inhibiting a target that is manually asserted directly causally upstream of a top-ranked disease driver can propagate a therapeutic effect.
results.body: drug decreases bound target; GO-CAM target causes top-three causal disease driver
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule uses a manually curated, publication-backed GO-CAM causal edge, but RO:0002630 does not preserve positive versus negative influence and disease-driver direction is also absent.
results.trapi_notes: The direct causal path is TRAPI-expressible; GO-CAM provenance, driver rank, identity, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[step:CAUSES]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND 'infores:go-cam' IN coalesce(step.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Two-step GO-CAM causal propagation
results.hypothesis: A two-step manually curated GO-CAM causal chain can connect an inhibited target to a top-ranked disease driver beyond local two-hop motifs.
results.body: drug decreases bound target; two GO-CAM causes edges reach top-three causal disease driver
results.mechanism_rationale: The five-edge body uses two independent publication-backed causal assertions, but sign loss at either RO:0002630 edge can invert the therapeutic interpretation.
results.trapi_notes: The two-step causal path is TRAPI-expressible; source provenance, node distinctness, driver rank, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[step1:CAUSES]->(middle:Gene)
      -[step2:CAUSES]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> middle
  AND middle <> driver
  AND target <> driver
  AND 'infores:go-cam' IN coalesce(step1.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:go-cam' IN coalesce(step2.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Causal-enzyme substrate exposure diagnostic
results.hypothesis: A drug that is both a substrate and inhibitor of a causal enzyme might modulate the corresponding disease.
results.body: causal gene has drug as ChEMBL substrate; drug directly binds and decreases same top-three disease gene
results.mechanism_rationale: The observed ABCG2-gout cohort is more naturally interpreted as altered exposure or toxicity risk than therapeutic correction, so this motif is retained only as negative evidence.
results.trapi_notes: The substrate, target, and disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; rank and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (gene:Gene)-[:HAS_SUBSTRATE]->(subject:Drug)
MATCH (subject)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
